description: This file is a source code file written in C that implements ASN.1 object structures and functions related to private key information, including RSA and DSA private keys, and associated ASN.1 handling logic. It includes functions for creating, initializing, exporting, and decrypting private keys, as well as handling ASN.1 encoding/decoding operations.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_ENCRYPTEDPRIVATEKEYINFO
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence object representing an encrypted private key info, including encryption algorithm and encrypted data.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_ENCRYPTIONALGORITHMIDENTIFIER
classes.description: ASN.1 object representing encryption algorithm identifier.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_PRIVATEKEYINFO
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence object for private key info, including key version, algorithm, private key data, and attributes.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_PRIVATEKEY

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_RSAPRIVATEKEY
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence object representing RSA private key components.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DSAPRIVATEKEY
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence object representing DSA private key components.
